svg.title: Thanksgiving at SpaceX: style sheet 1 (2D cartoon)
svg.text: model sheet · style 1 · 2D cartoon (rev. 3: show-model Elon, Rick + Morty)
vector only · flat colour + one shade · thin even ink (~4u outline, ~2u inner) · dot pupils
light from upper right · shade side always faces left
champagne steel · disc wheels · butterfly doors
inside: 2 seats, centre screen, no steering wheel or pedals
